customer: hey so i traded in my suv at northwind and i think my autopay still went thru to my lender after u guys paid it off?? im a broke college student lol so i really need that money back, do i get it from u or what
agent: Good news: if your lender received both our payoff and one of your regular payments, that extra amount belongs to you. Your lender refunds it directly to you, usually within 2 to 4 weeks after the loan is closed. Northwind doesn't receive or forward overpayments, so if the refund doesn't show up, please reach out to your lender directly.
